commands.command:
set -eu
WT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-20261104-v1"
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
cd "$WT/frontend"
npm run format:check
set +e
python3 "$ROOT/scripts/quality/css_token_gate.py" > /tmp/photomap-css-main-gate.log 2>&1
base=$?
python3 "$WT/scripts/quality/css_token_gate.py" > /tmp/photomap-css-unified-gate.log 2>&1
feature=$?
set -e
echo "CSS_BASE_GATE=$base CSS_FEATURE_GATE=$feature"
echo "BASE_FINDINGS"; grep '^-' /tmp/photomap-css-main-gate.log | head -n 16 || true
echo "FEATURE_FINDINGS"; grep '^-' /tmp/photomap-css-unified-gate.log | head -n 16 || true
echo UX_CSS_BASELINE_COMPARED
